question.content:
Look at the pattern below.

![step 1 with 1 square](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/f26865d28d1f463bb4ff7a7add809b7bc8c4a879) ![step 2 with 3 squares](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/4b6e5feb486d00e6f3022109280e92a51d0cf4f9) ![step 3 with 6 squares](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/923ca636023ec04b89cc835f515dc7dfaa2355d7) ![step 4 with 10 squares](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/d2f2da8f5d279e4349f536914f301ab5c8d7c217)

**How does the pattern grow at each step?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

choices.content: It grows by 2 squares each step.
It grows by 3 squares each step.
It grows by 2 squares, then 3 squares, then 4 squares.
It grows by 2 squares, then 4 squares, then 8 squares.
